metadata.verification: District tier verified against Zimbabwe National Statistics Agency (ZimStat) census-tabulated districts (citypopulation.de), cross-checked against Wikipedia 'Districts of Zimbabwe'. Constituency and ward TOTALS verified against the ZEC 2023 Delimitation Report (finalized Feb 2023) as tabulated on Wikipedia's 'List of wards of Zimbabwe' — per-province figures sum exactly to the national totals of 210 constituencies and 1,970 wards. Constituency NAMES verified per-province against current (post-2023) constituency listings; 5 of 10 provinces (Bulawayo, Harare, Manicaland, Mashonaland Central, Mashonaland West) from clean single-source lists, the remaining 5 reconstructed by filtering a mixed historical/current Wikipedia list and cross-checked to match official per-province totals exactly. Checked 2026-08-19.
metadata.known_uncertainty: Midlands Province constituency list includes both 'Chirumanzu' and 'Chirumanzu-Zibagwe' as returned by the source; these may represent a pre-2008 constituency alongside its 2008-successor rather than two distinct current constituencies. Flagged as name_confidence: flagged_for_spotcheck on the 'Chirumanzu' entry. All other entries carry name_confidence: verified. Local-authority counts for Mashonaland West and Matabeleland North are each one short of the figure stated on the wards-of-Zimbabwe summary page (13 vs 14, and 9 vs 10 respectively) — likely a single local authority not captured in the ZimStat district tabulation used here; flagged for spot-check rather than guessed at.
metadata.pattern_note: Zimbabwe's pattern is Province -> District (Local Authority: Rural District Council or Urban Council/Municipality) -> Constituency -> Ward. Wards are numbered per local authority (not nationally unique), and constituency boundaries can span or subdivide a district's wards — the exact ward-to-constituency allocation is only confirmed in full for Bulawayo, Harare and Manicaland Provinces from the source consulted.
metadata.ward_tier_note: Ward tier: per-province TOTAL counts (ward_count_verified) are confirmed exactly against the ZEC 2023 Delimitation Report and sum to 1,970 nationally. Individual ward-to-constituency numbering is a placeholder (count: null) at the constituency level for 7 of 10 provinces, pending ZEC Annexure B ward boundary description lookups.
